key_insight: Vero provides a fully open reinforcement-learning training recipe that produces vision-language models matching or exceeding existing open-weight models on diverse visual reasoning tasks.
problem_solved: Brings transparency and reproducibility to the opaque, proprietary RL pipelines used to build strong visual reasoners, enabling community access to the methods and models needed for broad visual reasoning across charts, science, spatial tasks, and open-ended problems.
method: Design and publish a fully open RL training recipe tailored for vision-language models (VLMs).
Scale the RL pipeline across diverse visual-reasoning datasets and task types (charts, scientific diagrams, spatial understanding, open-ended visual QA).
Train and evaluate a family of Vero models, comparing them to existing open-weight baselines and releasing models/artifacts for the community.
impact: Vero democratizes state-of-the-art visual reasoning by making the training recipe, models, and evaluations public, improving reproducibility and accelerating development of multimodal AI systems.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart showing inputs (images + text), RL loop, and model updates (policy/value components) to illustrate the open recipe.
Bar chart comparing Vero vs open-weight baselines across representative benchmarks (charts, science, spatial, open-ended).
Task montage (thumbnail grid) showing example tasks: chart interpretation, diagram reasoning, spatial scene question, open-ended visual QA.
Icon-based checklist highlighting: Open recipe, Scaled training, Released models, Reproducible evaluation.
paper_title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
paper_authors: Gabriel Sarch, Linrong Cai, Qunzhong Wang, Haoyang Wu, Danqi Chen
